tr: Wa kun Yā Khabīru kāshifan li kurūbinā
wa bi ‘l-ḥilmi khalliq Yā Ḥalīmu nufūsanā
en: Be, O Aware, a removal of our distress – With forbearance, O Forbearing perfume our souls

ar: وَ فِيْ مَقْعَدِ الصِّدْقِ الْأَجَلِّ أَحِلَّنَا
en: With knowledge aggrandize,O Great,our affairs – In the seat of most sublime truthfulness,make our state
blocks.review: شُءُوْنَنَا: printed with a single wāw and the hamza (with ḍamma) floating above the shīn–wāw join, encoded with standalone ء as on p115.

en: Forgiving and Appreciative, favoritism does not cease – So with gratitude and forgiveness, my Master select us
High and Magnificent, beyond all imagination – So Glorified are You, O Allah, from the descriptions of the injurious

ar: وَكُنْ لِيْ حَفِيْظًا يَا حَفِيْظُ مِنَ الْبَلَا
tr: Wa kun lī ḥafīẓan Yā Ḥafīẓu mina ‘l-balā
Muqītun aqitnā khayra qūtin wa hanninā
en: Be for me a protection, O Protector, from misfortune – Maintainer, nourish us with the best and make us happy
